jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Trust and Safety Engineering - 2027 Start

jobs.description:

- Understand product objectives and improve trust and safety strategy and model performance

- Curate, preprocess, and manage large-scale datasets for training and evaluation, ensuring data quality, diversity, and reproducibility

- Final year of study or recently graduated (2027 start)
- Solid experience in at least one area: machine learning, pattern recognition, NLP, data mining, or computer vision
- Proficiency in Python; familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow
